data.name: YokesDoomedWish
data.detailed_description:
[Game Overview]

Embark on a narrative-driven 2D pixel-art Metroidvania RPG. Explore an interconnected world, uncover hidden secrets, and let the story guide your journey.

[Story]

"Ever since I became an Administrator, my workload has only grown..." Yuka sighed.

She used to be an ordinary girl without any strong convictions. It was only at her best friend's insistence that she joined the Matrix Management Council. Yet, to everyone's surprise, she was unexpectedly elected as an Administrator in the last Node Election.

"Sister, there's a letter for you... it's... it's from Lord Luna Zhu!" her younger sister, Yuri, called out in a hurry...

Thus, a newly appointed Administrator sets out on an experiment that intertwines her fate with the world—and her own Doomed Wish.

[Combat]

Designed with a low difficulty curve, the game offers a smooth and accessible experience, featuring two distinct types of combat:

Exploration Combat: Engage enemies in adventure zones to clear paths and unlock new areas. (Though sometimes, running past them is a valid exploration strategy!)

Story Boss Battles: Face off against formidable foes at key narrative milestones. Defeat them to push the story forward.

[Exploration & Items]

Discover multiple interconnected maps, with new regions unlocking as the story progresses. Utilize a diverse array of items in your inventory to overcome obstacles and enrich your exploration experience.
